newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ICICI 96/97 loan disbursals up.
newsitem.headline: India's ICICI 96/97 loan disbursals up.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) said on Thursday its loan disbursements rose more than 30 percent in the first few months of the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997.

"The performance during the current year till date has been satisfactory. The Corporation's loan disbursements so far have exceeded those of the previous year by over 30 percent," ICICI chairman N. Vaghul said in a speech read out at the firm's annual shareholder meeting.
He did not specify the exact period.

Vaghul said the outlook for the current year remained good and said organisational restructuring initiated recently had largely been implemented, bolstering competitiveness, efficiency and the group's profit performance.
"The future focus of your corporation would be on the key parameters of asset growth, return on assets and return on equity," he said.
